description: Common-pole Foster thermal ROM (ARCHITECTURE 5.3): step response sum_k r_k (1 - exp(-t/tau_k)), residues in K/W, sources normalized to 1 W, observers are weighted averages.

conventions.self: source of ring i -> observer of ring i; site observers/sources at site_offsets_um
conventions.cross_distance: source centre (ring centre, or site centre for driver/aggressor) to observer centre (ring centre for ring_mode_weighted/heater_resistor, site centre for monitor_pd/temp_sensor); radially symmetric approximation, valid d > 2R

observer_weights.ring_mode_weighted: n dn/dT |E|^2 of TE0 (femwell) x 2 pi r
observer_weights.heater_resistor: volume average of the heater body
observer_weights.monitor_pd: disk r = 3.0 um at film mid-plane
observer_weights.temp_sensor: disk r = 2.0 um at film mid-plane

source_weights.waveguide_absorption: |E|^2 of TE0 in Si (free-carrier absorption) x 2 pi r
source_weights.junction: density ~ 1/t^2 in the rib and the slab within 1.0 um of the rib (lateral series-resistance current path)
source_weights.driver: uniform disk r = 5.0 um in the 88.0 nm CMOS film
source_weights.aggressor: uniform disk r = 10.0 um in the CMOS film

radius_um: Lightmatter '~15 um diameter' (HC, LM26-S); GF PDK MRM R = 7.5 um (GF-ECIO)
film_nm: 45SPCLO 160 nm photonics SOI (GF-IMAPS); 200 nm = SMTAI render (hypothesis D21)
die_side_mm: 5 x 5 mm = 45SPCLO MPW block (Europractice, printed); the G25/G26 die is not printed
h_bottom_w_per_m2_k: die attach + package to a TEC-held plate (R'' = 5e-5 m^2 K/W)
beol_lo_um: 9-level BEOL printed, total thickness not public
beol_hi_um: 9-level BEOL printed, total thickness not public
fill_lo: effective Cu area fraction of the thin levels
fill_hi: effective Cu area fraction of the thick levels
via_ratio: via area fraction relative to the line fill
keepout_um: metal no-fill zone beyond the ring radius (imec: tiling costs up to 60 %)
heater_gap_um: in-ring heater placement ('heater and PN inside the ring', LM26-S schematic)
sil_gap_um: GF PDK: four silicide resistors, two inside, two outside (GF-ECIO); spacing assumed
undercut_depth_um: isotropic Si undercut depth; imec UCUT ~27 x 45 um^2 (CO22-JLT)
metal_gap_um: metal heater height above the film
pitch_um: ring pitch on the TX bus not published (04 open question 2)
site_offsets_um: PD near the drop port, sensor, monolithic driver, aggressor (G26: heater adjacent to the MRM)

materials.si_index_model: li1980 temperature shape on the frey level

material_notes: air (undercut) k = 0.026 W/(m K), rho c = 1.2e3 J/(m^3 K): handbook, not in mrm.materials
slab and CMOS film k clamped to the 150 nm value of k_si_film_w_per_m_k (fit valid 150-300 nm)
BEOL effective medium: k_r = f k_Cu + (1-f) k_d, k_z = f_via k_Cu + k_d/(1-f) (assumed)

assumption_ranges.note: 1-sigma ranges are the assumed sigmas of the geometry Jacobian (stages.uncertainty.jacobian); sweep ranges are the variants of stages.uncertainty.sweeps; 'not swept' ranges are plausible values no run has explored (their sensitivity is unknown); 'printed' values carry the Jacobian sigma of the reading (radius) or of the process (BOX)

convergence.note: rel_err_est is |f(production level) - f(Richardson extrapolation)| / |f_extrapolated| from the last three levels (or the last change when convergence is not monotone)

conservative_bound.note: bound on |f(production) - f(converged)| / |f(production)| from the stored levels: geometric tail of the changes when they shrink monotonically above the re-meshing noise, else the largest of the last two changes; never below rel_err_est. It exceeds rel_err_est where the observed order is < 1 (Richardson clamps the order to >= 1)

memory_cap.reason: the first default extraction with production at 35 nm was killed by memguard at 3.10 GB (2026-10-09 09:02 UTC, before the Krylov-basis and SuperLU-ordering memory fixes); production moved to 50 nm and 35 nm stayed as the finest convergence level
memory_cap.fits_6gb: yes (estimate): the 35 nm models have 1.7x the DOF of production; production jobs at 50 nm peaked at 1.1-2.3 GB after the memory fixes
memory_cap.consequence: negligible: the 35 nm level would move every tracked metric by <= the change above, inside the stated mesh error

rom.taus_note: taus_vf_s are the vector-fitting poles before the variable-projection polish (rom.varpro) and the pole separation; the final shared poles are taus_s in the .npz (strictly increasing)

validation.superposition_note: max over pairs and over t in [10 ns, 10 ms] of |y_bank(t) - y_ax(t)| / y_ax(inf) for the 8-ring 3-D bank (inring_noundercut 160, pitch 50.0 um, dirichlet bottom under 200.0 um substrate, 3-D mesh 0.4 um at the rings); y_ax = the axisymmetric single-ring FEM of the same variant at the exact bank distances, so the Foster-fit error (validation.all_pairs) and the distance-interpolation error of the cross_r_um grid (log-log, max 0.0253 at the bank distances; stages.crosscheck_3d.distance_interpolation of thermal_rom_inring_noundercut_160.json) come on top; measured on the default family only; it mixes 3-D discretization error and multibody effects (decomposition keys max_discretization_dc_rel_all / max_multibody_step_err_frac_all in stages.crosscheck_3d.bank are pending)

k_temp_scaling.method: 07 P2-5 quasi-static: DC gains and 63 % times recomputed with k(T) and rho c(T) of mrm.materials; the runtime scales residues by the DC ratio and taus by the t63 ratio

uncertainty_thermal_suggestion.note: independent Gaussian parameters with the assumed sigmas; bottom/substrate/die choices are in sweeps

g25_consistency.note: rom_dc_scale = (FSR/P_FSR) / (Z * dlambda/dT) per variant; 1 means the variant reproduces the G25 median efficiency under that hypothesis
g25_consistency.hypotheses_note: rom_dc_scale_by_hypothesis re-evaluated by --stage propagate from the stored z_heater_ring_k_per_mw with the hypotheses above (the same set as rom_dc_scale)

crosscheck_analytic.method: FEM (structured interface-aligned P2 mesh) vs exact layered Hankel-Laplace solution (LayeredAnalytic); laterally uniform stack with a continuous 160 nm Si film; annular volume source in the film; observers: the same annulus, an annulus 2-3 um inside, victim annuli at distance d

disagreements_above_1pct.note: every point listed has an absolute error <= 1.25e-05 of the self DC; points whose response is >= 1e-5 of the self DC: [('victim@100um', 10000.0), ('victim@20um', 1000000.0), ('victim@300um', 0.0), ('victim@300um', 10.0), ('victim@300um', 1000.0), ('victim@50um', 100000.0)] (cause, Hankel quadrature or FEM, not separated; the FEM mesh change there is listed and is far smaller than the disagreement)

bank.target: superposition error < 10 % on the crosstalk residues (07 P1-3)
bank.metric: max over t in [10 ns, 10 ms] of |y_bank(t) - y_ROM(t)| / y_ROM(inf) per crosstalk pair; the earlier residue_l1 numbers are kept for reference but are ill-posed (non-unique real-pole residues)

silicide_arcs.note: the ring observer is the full-ring mode-weighted average; arcs leave the coupler regions free

derived_equal_mesh.method: pure arithmetic on the two stored single-ring levels, f(h) = f0 + c h^p with p = 1 and p = 2 (the order is not identifiable from two levels); no solver run
derived_equal_mesh.lead_effect_recorded_note: the recorded lead_effect_* compares leads at h 0.4 um with no leads at h 0.35 um (unequal meshes, a side effect of the 3 GB coarsening); the equal-mesh values above replace them

bank_self_split.note: split of the driven ring's Z_heater_ring difference (bank vs axisymmetric ROM, -6.6 %): 3-D vs axisymmetric at 0.4 um without leads (-2.8 %: the 3-D discretization error plus the formulation gap, -0.2 .. -1.6 % by order-1..2 extrapolation; the two are not separable from two levels) x own leads (-4.0 %) x multibody (+0.03 .. +0.10 %); the first two multiply to the stored single-ring-with-leads value by construction, so the information is the split, not a check
bank_self_split.discretization_at_h_0p4_note: named 'discretization' for brevity: it is the whole 3-D vs axisymmetric difference at h 0.4 um (discretization + formulation)

reductions.when: 2026-10-09 08:51 UTC, before any 3-D run, 'to stay well under the 3 GB limit for the 8-ring bank' (the bank used the finest single level)
reductions.consequence: two levels only (no third refinement): the 3-D vs axisymmetric gap (-2.5 % Z_heater_ring, -4.9 % Z_heater_heater at 0.35 um) cannot be split into formulation and discretization; extrapolation with p = 1..2 leaves a formulation gap of -0.2 .. -1.6 % (Z_hr) and +0.8 .. -2.6 % (Z_hh)
reductions.fits_6gb: yes: 0.25 um single ring = 166,716 tets (no leads), 291,178 tets (leads, bus, victim margin)

reductions.consequence: one bank level, no bank convergence: the 13.9 % superposition error contains an unmeasured 3-D discretization share
reductions.fits_6gb: estimated yes, with little margin: ~1.51 M tets (extrapolated), peak 4.7-5.4 GB scaled from the recorded 2.28 GB peak of the 0.4 um run (635 k tets); a further level at 0.18 um (~2.8 M tets, ~8-10 GB) does not fit

reductions.consequence: arcs vs annuli (+1.03 %) is a same-mesh ratio (insensitive); full 3-D vs axisymmetric (-7.0 %) carries the 3-D discretization error
computed at unequal meshes (-4.3 %); -4.0 % at equal mesh (derived_equal_mesh)

not_reductions: 3.41 GB kill (quick 3-D run): pyamg operator complexity on mass-dominated shifts -> Jacobi-preconditioned CG for those shifts (CG rtol 1e-11; ROM DC error <= 1.2e-9): no accuracy loss
3.97 GB kill (3-D stage start): skfem probes locator -> memory-bounded exact tetrahedron locator (reconstruction error 2e-16): no accuracy loss

mesh_counts.note: [nodes, tets]; the 8-ring count at 0.25 um is 1 ring + 7 x (2-ring - 1-ring); the same rule predicts the meshed 8-ring count at 0.4 um to +0.6 %; meshing the 8-ring bank at 0.4 um alone peaked at 0.80 GB RSS

decomposition.status: not run: the re-run that computes the discretization / multibody split of the 13.9 % (keys max_discretization_dc_rel_all, max_multibody_dc_rel_all, max_multibody_step_err_frac_all, pairs[].dc_3d_single) was interrupted by the session restart of 2026-10-09 16:28 UTC

pending.runtime_fallback: the radial cross_res table of the axisymmetric ROM is used as is (3-D bank values are 2-14 % lower at 50-350 um); mrm.plant.thermal.load_rom warns that superposition_rel_err 0.139 > 0.10; uncertainty.thermal.crosstalk_scale (g26: loguniform 0.33-1.73) covers the gap

k_temp_scaling.note: 07 P2-5 quasi-static scaling: multiply residues by dc_ratio(T) and taus by tau_ratio(T) (T = mean temperature of the conduction path, K); k(T), rho c(T) from mrm.materials
